title: frangula atroviridis
intro: Frangula atroviridis, commonly known as Black Alder or Black Buckthorn, is a plant species belonging to the Rhamnaceae family. It is valued for its traditional medicinal uses, which include treating various health conditions such as constipation, diarrhea, and liver disorders due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include stimulating bowel movements, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of Frangula atroviridis include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin and emodin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
